WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaType.Name,
    CAST(SUM(Track.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(20,8)) / CAST(SUM(Track.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(20,8)) as rate
  FROM Track
  JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT 
  mtr.Name,
  mtr.rate,
  mtr.rate - oa.avg_rate as above_average
FROM media_type_rates mtr
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE mtr.rate > oa.avg_rate
ORDER BY mtr.Name
